comment: A gem. Hilarious, quirky, AND explains OChem lecture great, which is a feat few can claim. Super helpful, (hint-ask him about lab questions, he literally wrote the book). It's Ochem, so it's gonna be hard, but put in the work studying and you're golden. Made my day every time I walked into class. He and Gupton are why I'm a chem major

Took him for OrgoLab. He's hilarious professor to have. He's easy to talk to and fun to listen to.  Loves his coffee and loves to say "Hot Dog!". Can't speak for his lectures, but definitely take him for Lab.
This class was harder than I expected. But Miller is really cool and helpful. If you go to him, even if you're not that great at chemistry, he will help your grade.
there isnt a better prof at richmond. you have no idea until you take ochem w/ him.

Dr. Rob is the best chem professor I have ever met.  He goes above and beyond in making sure every student knows what's going on and has fun in the process.  Take any lab that he teaches!!!  He is a all around wonderful person!
Totally HOT! Greatest teacher ever! Makes organic chemistry fun. Thank you God!! Funny, laid back, fair grader...the BEST!
Very cool guy. If you can take lecture or lab with him def do so. Also he is very interested in rock climbing so you should try it with him some time. very cool dude

great teacher to have for lab and class.  he puts everything in laimens terms and if u study there is no reason for failure.  he's also a very ENERGETIC teacher who loves tangents.  Bests teacher in like, the world :)
Rob is such a nice guy i would take every lab i could with him.  I would go to him for help with lecture instead of Clough.
He's a great dynamic teacher. he keeps the class interesting and is very straighforward and wonderfully clear. He's just a great Lab Instructor! Helpful when asked and just fun
A little spastic at times, but teaches the material well.  Keeps class upbeat and somehow fun!  Gives straightforward quizzes and tests.
Great Teacher.  Would highly recommend.  Teaches the hard subject of Ochem really well, and is able to help students understand the material
Great teacher. Very helpful outside of class. He definitely knows his stuff.
